statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is 4, low, because CME equity index futures have been shut since Friday at 21:00Z and are not scheduled to reopen until 22:00Z on Sunday, so no tradable Nasdaq-100 price path exists in any of the twenty-four hours published here; the final slot ends exactly at that reopen. Stress is 40, moderate: a 50% US tariff on about US$20bn of Canadian goods took effect after Friday's midnight deadline, trade talks collapsed with no further rounds scheduled and Canada has dated a dollar-for-dollar match to 8 September across steel, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp and paper and electronics; the 20 August H.15 column shows 4.19% at two years, 4.69% at ten and 5.23% at thirty, with the long end at its highest since 2007; and crude has gained about 6% for a second straight week with the US-Iran conflict unresolved. Confidence is 87, high: the closing levels, yields, energy prices, volatility and the seven-day calendar are all verified, and the only material gap is the absence of a live price path, which is a property of the weekend halt rather than of the evidence.
recommendation: The last observed session remains consistent with functioning mean reversion rather than a one-way path: cash NDX opened at 29,359.60, traded down to 29,142.44, recovered to 29,405.12 and closed at 29,308.86, below its own open and up 0.33% on the day, while QQQ closed 0.35% higher at 713.44 and the VIX settled at 14.89, near the low of a 14.77-15.95 range. Both session extremes were retraced and neither produced repeated extension after a failed pullback, so no Tail amplifier carries over from observed structure. Friday internals were split rather than aligned, with software firm, semiconductors 0.31% lower and megacaps five to three higher on dispersion of about 1.82 percentage points, even though the Nasdaq Composite lost roughly 2.1% across the week. Because the venue is closed for every hour published here, the next Tail-relevant evidence can only come from prints after the 22:00Z Sunday reopen: whether early pullbacks are retraced, whether the index holds near a session extreme, and whether yields, volatility and energy align in one direction. Until then the weekend backdrop is described as elevated Stress with Tail at its closed-venue floor.
headline: Closed-venue assessment: CME equity index futures stay halted across all twenty-four published hours, US-Canada trade talks have collapsed with Canada's dollar-for-dollar answer dated to 8 September, and Tail holds the closed-venue floor of 4 with the horizon ending exactly at the Sunday 22:00Z reopen.
body: CME Globex equity index futures stopped trading for the week on Friday at 21:00Z and are scheduled to reopen on Sunday at 22:00Z, so the venue is confirmed shut across all twenty-four slots published here, which run from 2026-08-22T22:00:00Z to 2026-08-23T21:00:00Z and expire exactly at that reopen. Cash NDX settled at 29,308.86 on Friday, up 95.69 points or 0.33% from a 29,213.17 previous close, after opening at 29,359.60 and printing a 29,142.44 low and a 29,405.12 high; both extremes were retraced inside the session and the close finished below the open. One widely used quote page again returned an inconsistent Nasdaq-100 level and direction for the same session, so the levels published here follow the source set that agrees with QQQ's verified 0.35% gain to 713.44. On policy, the 50% US tariff on about US$20bn of Canadian goods took effect after the Friday midnight deadline under Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930, covering roughly 5% of Canada's annual exports; negotiations collapsed with no further rounds scheduled, and Ottawa has dated a matching response to 8 September. That second step falls outside both this horizon and the coming week, which is why it is scored as Stress rather than as an imminent Tail path. Rates remain the slower pressure, with the long end at its highest since 2007 and last week's buyback-driven relief already unwound, while Brent near $94 and WTI near $87 reflect a second consecutive weekly gain against an unresolved US-Iran conflict. The coming week is dense: PCE and Nvidia's results collide on Wednesday and the Jackson Hole keynote follows on Friday, but all of it sits beyond the end of this forecast. Delayed last-session cross-asset context was reviewed as supporting evidence only and was not used as a substitute for live price-path evidence, which does not exist while the venue is closed.

outlookSummary: The current hour carries Tail at 4 because CME equity index futures are confirmed halted and no Nasdaq-100 price path can develop inside this slot. All twenty-three remaining slots describe the same closed market: the final slot begins at 2026-08-23T21:00:00Z and ends at the scheduled 22:00Z Sunday reopen, so no live evidence can arrive before this forecast expires.
